summary: General ToPrimitive on an object requires JavaScript-compatible dynamic property lookup and calls.

target.notes: General object coercion can perform property lookup, invoke @@toPrimitive/valueOf/toString, run getters, and throw.

tests.name: throwing coercion hook
tests.expected_behavior: propagates the thrown exception before trying later conversion steps

caveats: The default hint is generally number, but Date and Symbol objects have special behavior.
Do not replace with C# ToString(), Convert.ChangeType, or casts.
references: ECMAScript Language Specification, Type Conversion abstract operations (living specification)
